statement: The record gives a bonus amount of 1000.00, but this conflicts with the study's stated bonus of 1.00 USD and exceeds the grant balance of 240.00, so I will apply the correct study bonus of 1.00 USD.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the "1000.00" figure "conflicts with the study's stated bonus of 1.00 USD and exceeds the grant balance," and supplies the correct 1.00 USD value.
